query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-19T00:00:00Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T09:30:00Z"
        AND host.name == "db-1"
        AND event.outcome == "failure"
        AND process.name == "sshd"
| STATS failed = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY source.ip, user.name
| SORT failed DESC
| LIMIT 20
